brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the effect of glimepiride on dapagliflozin and the effect of dapagliflozin on glimepiride in healthy volunteers. In addition, the safety and tolerability of dapagliflozin with be assessed alone and while taking glimepiride
brief_title: Pharmacokinetic Drug Interaction Study With Dapagliflozin and Glimepiride in Healthy Subjects

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy subjects with BMI of 18-32 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abnormal physical or lab findings
* Allergies to any sulfonylurea or related compounds

official_title: Pharmacokinetic Drug Interaction Study With Dapagliflozin and Glimepiride in Healthy Subjects

primary_outcomes.measure: Maximum plasma concentration and exposure to glimepiride and dapagliflozin when administered alone and administered together
primary_outcomes.time_frame: plasma concentrations will be measures as specified timepoints for 72 hours after each administred dose
